neighbours.label: the evaluative complement of a 'To say/call X … would be' hedging frame
fire: To claim that the show was a success would be an overstatement.
To say the food was bland would be kind.
To call the meeting productive would be a stretch.
To describe the hotel as cozy would be charitable.
To suggest that he was unprepared would be unfair.
To say that the weather was poor would be an understatement.
To argue that prices will fall soon would be naive.
To call the referee's decision odd would be polite.
quiet: The show was a big success, and everyone agreed.
The food was bland, and nobody finished it.
The meeting was productive and ended early.
The hotel was cozy and close to the station.
He was unprepared and lost the debate.
The weather was poor all through the weekend.
Prices will fall next year, analysts predict.
The referee's decision was odd, fans complained.

notes: Low-max broad pole, multilingual (Russian participles, commas). Card had 'To⟦ say⟧ that…'; one probe peaked at ' generous' in such a frame. Weak guess.
